thread:
Maya: Taking primary for 19:00-03:00 UTC. Raj will be secondary. Quick notes: saw sporadic p99 token latency earlier — root cause suspected: KV cache compaction thrash on shard 7. Leaving runbook + immediate mitigations below.

incident-bot: PAGER — p99 inference-latency > 1.8s for 15m on prod-us-west. Pager severity: SEV3

Maya: timeline — 18:10 noticed p95 spikes, 18:23 deploy rolled back, 18:30 traffic normalized but p99 still high.

Raj: ok, thanks. any customer impact? which routes?

Maya: Affected routes: /v1/chat (small fraction), routing to model-redwood/xl. Logged errors: KV cache misses up ~3x. No errored requests, just latency.

Lucy: FYI ops-dashboard shows KV shard 7 CPU hot, GC churn. Might be a worker restart helps.

Maya: Runbook snippets: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/kv-cache-thrash

Maya: Quick checklist below — try in order and report results. Paste outputs here.

Maya:
1) Drain and restart inference-workers on shard 7:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deploy inference-worker-shard7 --replicas=0
sleep 10
kubectl -n inference scale deploy inference-worker-shard7 --replicas=3
```
2) If p99 still >1s, enable fallback routing to model-redwood/xl-quant:
```
PATCH /routing/policies
{ "target": "model-redwood/xl-quant", "weight": 20 }
```
3) If cache miss rate > 2x baseline, toggle prefix caching off for affected route:
```
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/configs/cache/toggle -d '{"route":"/v1/chat","enable":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN'
```
4) If none works, scale dedicated pool by +2 GPUs: infra-runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/scale-gpu-pool

Maya: I'll run step 1 now.

deploy-bot: Starting rollout restart for inference-worker-shard7 (deploy: inference-worker-shard7) by Maya

devops-bot: Rollout complete: inference-worker-shard7 now at 3 replicas

Maya: After restart p99 dropped from 1.9s -> 0.9s. Still watching. Leaving note for night team: warm cache by running the warmup job if you see regression.

Ken: Noted. I'll follow at 21:30 and run warmup if spikes reappear. Any quick playbook link for warmup?

Maya: warmup job: https://internal.redwood/tools/cache-warmup — run `./warmup.sh --shard=7 --concurrency=8`

Raj: copying runbook and commands into handoff doc. Anything else?

Maya: Add: if p99 climbs back above 1.5s and CPU > 85%, escalate to infra on-call @Ken and consider draining shard for blue/green swap. Playbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/bluegreen-swap

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: primary=Maya, secondary=Raj, shift=19:00-03:00 UTC, notes=https://internal.redwood/handoffs/4123456789

Maya: thanks team. I left a short test prompt set in the handoff doc for ongoing regression checks. :thumbsup:

Raj: ack. I'll monitor alerts and post status every 45m or on change.

Lucy: good handoff. I'm available if you need infra escalation tonight.

Maya: Closing the thread, will update if anything else.
